page.overview:
Who is Andromeda?

Andromeda is flashy and outspoken, the kind of reporter who thrives on soundbites and style over details like substance and basic facts. Unfortunately, however, these bad habits have landed her in more than one predicament. {| class="fandom-table"

"Cybertron has come down with a fever... Lobbing fever. If you have the fever, there's only one cure. Take two tickets and see the game Sunday morning. Warning: tickets should not be taken internally." Andromeda was nervous on her first appearance for ABN's Around Cybertron, and during a segment on Lobbing, managed to hit Bishop in the head. At the end, Rook asked her how she thought it had gone, and she confessed her nervousness and hoped Bishop was all right. Apparently he was, as he and Cassiopeia joined her while Rook signed off the show. Around Cybertron #18

Andromeda was an anchor working for Fever Dream in the Iacon Communications Service. She was assimilated by the Vehicons with the rest of her news crew during the Vehicon Apocalypse when the drones turned on the Builders. Derailment

"Voxpop, without knowing precisely what the danger is, would you say it's time for our viewers to crack each other's heads open and feast on the goo inside?"
